$description: Ondo Perps order form tokens · DTCG 2025.10 · generated by build.mjs from tokens/*.json. Default modes: Theme Classic, Layout Desktop, Motion Default. Other modes in $extensions["com.ondo.modes"].

sunken.$description: Wells set into a surface: inputs, tracks

inverse.$description: Small light elements on dark: thumbs, knobs

default.$description: Promotions and new things: fee discount

primary.$description: Values and active labels. 18.4:1 on surface

disabled.$description: Disabled text and placeholders only. Exempt from 4.5:1

inverse.$description: Text on bold and inverse fills

numeric.$description: Font for numbers: values, inputs, prices. Words stay in the label font.

muted.$description: Decorative layers shown at half strength (slider ramp)

xs.$description: Inline pickers inside a field: unit toggle

knob.$description: Round thumb inside an xs control with 2px padding: size.control.xs minus 4 (switch)

control-sm.$description: Small standalone controls: badges, icon buttons, slider thumb

control-nested.$description: An item inside a padded track (tab, segment indicator): radius.control minus the 2px track padding (8→6 Classic, 12→10 Modern), so the corners stay concentric

md.$description: Amount input. 16px also prevents iOS zoom on focus.

lg.$description: Order amount: the one number the trader types on every order

move.$description: Something travels: Long/Short indicator, slider snap

reveal.$description: Content appears or collapses: TP/SL, inline errors

loop.$description: One turn of a continuous indicator (spinner). Kept in Reduced mode: it is essential feedback.

notice.$description: How long a transient notice (toast) stays before it leaves on its own

emphasized.$description: Quick start, soft settle: travel and sheets

validate.$description: Pause before a soft validation error (below minimum) shows while typing

handle.$description: Separates a light knob from a light track

glow.$description: Soft light halo for a disabled handle (original: 10px; snapped to the 12 step)

pressed.$description: Press feedback on the trade CTA

size-sm.$description: Icon-only, size sm: square hit area

size-xs.$description: Icon-only, size xs (20). Hit area extended to size.target.min in code

underline.$description: Dotted underline on a label that opens a modal or tooltip

value.$description: Value and unit in the md field (prices, %), as in Figma

value-lg.$description: Value and unit in the lg field (amount), as in Figma

fill.$description: Mask shape only; the ramp shows through

length.$description: Vertical divider height inside a row

inline-gap.$description: Side-by-side items, e.g. quick-size stops, options row
